title.narrative: Competitiveness, Industrial Modernization, and Trade Acceleration Program, Subprogram 1

description.narrative: The proposed program is geared towards helping Indonesia achieve faster growth that is both inclusive and sustainable, in order to realize its development aspirations. The program comes at a critical time as the country tries to turn a corner on the COVID-19 pandemic and will focus on (i) creating an enabling environment for investments, (ii) easing barriers to trade, and (iii) growing and upscaling enterprises.
